about_the_game:
This is a frame-by-frame platformer that requires no precise controls—you don't even need a keyboard.
As long as you can use a mouse and pause at any time for fine-tuning, you can pull off god-tier moves like a platforming pro.

Content

  • Approximately 1 hours of gameplay

  • 23 closely spaced checkpoints

  • CatFather

short_description: This is a frame-by-frame platformer. In an abstract, childlike world, command the CatFather and make frame-level adjustments to ensure he safely reaches the next paper tube and returns to his cat tree. Help the CatFather ascend to the peak of Huff-and-Puff Summit!
